policy: V15 adds deterministic accounting.statement-replay/v1 over immutable PeriodClose/AccountingClose evidence, reconstructible account.registry/v1, valuation.policy-artifact/v1 and RestatedPeriodView v1. It recalculates only independently reproducible accounting/NAV/P&L metrics; liquidity and distribution metrics remain explicitly NOT_PERFORMED.

additions.authority_note: Reference-only deterministic historical accounting replay. It verifies the original sealed LedgerEvent v2 prefix first, reconstructs chart/valuation semantics from portable artifacts, applies only explicit restatement exclusions, derives opening/closing period sequences from immutable closes, and recalculates HardNAV/LiquidNAV/EconomicNAV plus period realized revenue/P&L. It cannot mutate canonical history, calculate LCR/distribution metrics, authorize funds, or execute actions.
